supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: distinct lateral extension beyond the outer ocular corners

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: muzzle and sub-nasal region exhibit lower pixel intensity (lighter) relative to the dark cheek and periocular zones

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: thin vertical profile with no visible structural droop

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: light-colored mark or depigmentation on the upper helix of the left ear; melanin-rich freckling on the muzzle
other_distinctive_markers: multiple deep horizontal forehead furrows; sparse white hairs concentrated on the mental/chin region
